value.rationale: The naturally split bidirectional two-state Markov generator gives an exact all-positive-rates classification of a physical property of an explicit time integrator. The sharp b=2a reentrance transition shows nonmonotonic endpoint positivity even in two states and quantitatively separates endpoint sign tests from stage positivity and physical accuracy. This is a structural and reusable caution about monotone-CFL reasoning, not an arbitrary isolated parameter slice.
